summary: Backend + Frontend testing of Phase 2/3 Website Widget: Jessi chat door, Knowledge Base editor, page-rule greetings, public chat flow with real LLM, and preview overrides. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (test_website_widget_jessi.py). Frontend editor renders all 5 tabs (Look/Doors/Jessi/Routing/Install); Jessi tab exposes every documented section (test, welcome, facts, specials, never, notes, recent-chats); Doors tab shows chat door with all sub-fields; Look tab page-rules editor supports empty state, quick-add chips, add/remove, and Preview toggle mutates the iframe src to include &path=%2Finventory. Save persists across reload; Ask Jessi returned a real LLM answer in ~10s with no em dashes. Widget left in the required clean state (chat.on=true, page_rules=[], kb blank, QA facts removed, preserved store fact intact).
verified_flows: GET /api/widgets/{id} as manager: can_manage=true, facts[], recent_chats[], widget.kb {welcome, specials, never, notes, share_listed_prices}, widget.doors.chat {on,label,intro,button,placeholder,human}, widget.appearance.page_rules present.

PUT /api/widgets/{id} round-trip: 12-rule cap enforced (submitted 19 -> capped), rule without greeting dropped, bad door 'sms' becomes '', good rules preserved verbatim. kb.welcome/specials/never/notes/share_listed_prices all round-trip.
As rep (activation-tester): GET 200 with can_manage=false, PUT 403, POST facts 403.
POST /api/widgets/{id}/facts adds fact.id, appears in GET detail, DELETE removes it; preserved store fact 'We take walk-ins weekdays until 6 pm' untouched.

POST /api/widgets/{id}/ask 'What are your hours?' -> reply, handoff, reason, used {facts, specials, inventory_matches, inventory_total, hours} present; 'How much is the cheapest truck with financing?' -> handoff=true; no em dashes in either reply.

Public chat: POST /api/w/{key}/chat/start returns sid + greeting=kb.welcome when set; GET state has messages; POST message 'Are you open Saturday?' returns Jessi LLM reply; POST message 'What is my trade worth?' -> handoff/need_contact true; POST /contact with 5005550031 -> handoff true; fresh session POST /human -> need_contact true; bad sid -> 404.
Chat door off (PUT doors.chat.on=false) -> POST /chat/start 400; turning back on restores.

GET /api/w/{key}/demo?path=%2Finventory contains window.IMOS_WIDGET_PATH = "/inventory"; ?c=<b64 kb.welcome=Howdy> yields chat_welcome:"Howdy in HTML; GET /api/w/{key}.js contains 'page_rules' and does NOT expose kb notes/specials (KB stays private in non-preview JS).

Doors tab: widget-section-chat-door + widget-door-chat-on + widget-chat-label/intro/placeholder/human all visible. Editing widget-chat-label enables widget-save; Save shows toast 'Widget saved. Your site picks it up within two minutes.'; after in-app navigate-away/back, the new label persists (verified 'Chat with QA Jessi' reloaded), then restored to original.

Jessi tab: widget-section-test with widget-ask-input/widget-ask-btn produced widget-ask-answer (real LLM, ~10s). widget-section-welcome (widget-kb-welcome + widget-kb-share-prices), widget-section-facts (existing 'We take walk-ins weekdays until 6 pm' pill, widget-fact-input + widget-fact-add adds a new pill immediately with data-testid widget-fact-{id}-remove; removal works), widget-section-specials (widget-special-add), widget-section-never (widget-never-input/add + 4 built-in pills visible in screenshot), widget-section-notes (widget-kb-notes), widget-section-recent-chats all render.

Look tab: widget-section-page-rules with widget-page-rules-empty when list is empty; widget-page-rule-suggest-inventory quick-add creates a rule row with widget-page-rule-0-match/greeting/remove/preview and door chips widget-page-rule-0-door-'', -text, -call, -chat. Tapping widget-page-rule-0-preview toggles the widget-preview iframe src to include &path=%2Finventory (verified in src string).
Preview iframe: on Jessi tab the chat panel auto-opens showing 'Chat with Jessi' header and Jessi's welcome greeting text (screenshot confirmed).
Regression sanity: WIDGET_RING_DRY_RUN=true, and POST /api/w/{key}/text on qa-dealer.test page returns non-500 (200/403 depending on domain state).
critical_code_review_comments: Widget key rotates each time the pre-existing test_website_widget.py runs (test_rotate_key_kills_the_old_script). Future testing agents must always re-read the key from GET /api/widgets/{id} rather than caching. Current live key at end of this run: 8QpkPBWp.

The public /api/w/{key}.js response correctly excludes kb.notes/specials in non-preview mode; kb text is only rendered when ?c= override is provided (preview) or via chat_welcome. This privacy boundary is verified by tests.
